releasePairs.english: Choose a saved invoice price in the same currency, then confirm it for this sale. Only the line price changes; save the invoice when ready.
releasePairs.zu: Khetha intengo ekwi-invoyisi egciniwe ngohlobo olufanayo lwemali, bese uyayiqinisekisa kulokhu kuthengisa. Kushintsha intengo yalowo mugqa kuphela; gcina i-invoyisi uma usulungile.
releasePairs.st: Kgetha theko ya invoice e bolokilweng ka mofuta o tshwanang wa tjhelete, ebe o e netefatsa bakeng sa thekiso ena. Ho fetoha theko ya mola feela; boloka invoice ha o se o loketse.
releasePairs.ve: Nangani mutengo wa invoice yo vhulungwaho kha lushaka luthihi lwa tshelede, ni kone u u khwaṱhisedza kha iyi thengiso. Hu shanduka mutengo wa mutaladzi fhedzi; vhulungani invoice musi no lugela.
releasePairs.ts: Hlawula nxavo wa invoyisi leyi hlayisiweke hi muxaka lowu fanaka wa mali, kutani u wu tiyisisa eka ku xavisa loku. Ku cinca nxavo wa layini ntsena; hlayisa invoyisi loko u lunghekile.
